def f(z, y, Pssat, Ppsat, N, sigma_ap, sigma_ep, sigma_as, sigma_es,
      gamma_p, alpha_p, gamma_s, alpha_s):
    """Rate equations for the forward and backward pump and signal powers."""
    Pp_plus, Pp_minus, Ps_plus, Ps_minus = y

    Pp = Pp_plus + Pp_minus
    Ps = Ps_plus + Ps_minus

    Pp_norm = Pp / Ppsat
    Ps_norm = Ps / Pssat

    N2_over_N = (
        (sigma_ap / (sigma_ap + sigma_ep)) * Pp_norm
        + (sigma_as / (sigma_as + sigma_es)) * Ps_norm
    ) / (Pp_norm + 1.0 + Ps_norm)

    pump_absorption = gamma_p * (
        sigma_ap * N - (sigma_ap + sigma_ep) * N2_over_N
    )
    signal_gain = gamma_s * (
        (sigma_es + sigma_as) * N2_over_N - sigma_as * N
    )

    dPp_plus_dz = -pump_absorption * Pp_plus - alpha_p * Pp_plus
    dPp_minus_dz = pump_absorption * Pp_minus + alpha_p * Pp_minus
    dPs_plus_dz = signal_gain * Ps_plus - alpha_s * Ps_plus
    dPs_minus_dz = -signal_gain * Ps_minus + alpha_s * Ps_minus

    return np.array([
        dPp_plus_dz,
        dPp_minus_dz,
        dPs_plus_dz,
        dPs_minus_dz,
    ])


def bc(ya, yb, Ppl, Ppr, R1, R2):
    """Boundary conditions for an end-pumped bidirectional fiber laser."""
    return np.array([
        ya[0] - Ppl,
        yb[1] - Ppr,
        ya[2] - R1 * ya[3],
        yb[3] - R2 * yb[2],
    ])
